up-movie.intro: Up Movie illustrations include the balloon lifted house, Kevin, young Ellie and the dog pack. Adventure books, camping gear, flying objects and familiar keepsakes accompany the film characters in color and black and white drawings.

up.intro: Up arrows, pointing hands and stair climbing characters show direction and movement. Choose road signs, classroom word cards, rising balloons, upload symbols or black and white outlines; the collection also includes a wheelchair ramp, a growing sunflower and an ascending mountain trail.
